Public beta remains HOLD because the invite validator currently proves the registry is placeholder-only, PR #601 is open/blocked with no checks and still lacks production alias/env/maxDuration proof plus live synthetic latency scorecard evidence, PR #603 is open/blocked with no checks and keeps Cohort 1 launch execution, public beta, and model/NIM promotion on HOLD, PR #605 is draft, stacked on draft parent PR #604, has no attached checks, and lacks production alias/env/maxDuration proof plus live synthetic latency scorecard evidence, fresh current-deployment admin-positive proof, real invite-send proof, full cohort readout counts, privacy/support readiness, scheduler/shadow evidence, authenticated production recovery-checkpoint write/smoke proof, VET-1563 model-promotion evidence, and launch-stack PR check attachment remain missing or blocked.
